text:
sam.devex: Heads-up 1: repeated tickets about 'fetch is not defined' from sample-apps on Node 16. Need a concise pattern for quickstart.
lin.sdk: Proposal: SDK prefers globalThis.fetch when present. Export two opt-in helpers: `setFetchImplementation(fetchFn)` + `hasGlobalFetch()` and a `FetchLike` typedef. Avoid forcing global monkeypatch in library code.
irina.infra: strong agree on injection API. For Node <18 recommend undici@^5 in docs. Add a one-line global shim in examples for users who just want a quick fix.
todd.prod: From onboarding: provide 3 copy-paste snippets (Edge, Node>=18, Node<18) and a tiny troubleshooting table. Keep each snippet <=3 lines so folks paste without thinking.
lin.sdk: Draft snippets: ```js
// ESM Node <18
import { fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'
import { setFetchImplementation } from '@redwood/inference'
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
and CJS: ```js
const { fetch: undiciFetch } = require('undici')
const { setFetchImplementation } = require('@redwood/inference')
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
sam.devex: add a one-liner global shim for quickstart (with bundler caveat): `if (!globalThis.fetch) globalThis.fetch = (await import('undici')).fetch`
irina.infra: CI note: undici stream/abort semantics differ across versions; normalize Response/body streams in SDK and add Node 16/18/20 matrix. Also warn about retry behavior interacting with streaming bodies and token refresh on 401.
lin.sdk: We'll ship a small internal retry wrapper that retries only idempotent methods by default, uses AbortController, and exposes hooks for custom retry logic and token refresh. Typing: export `type FetchLike = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>` and attach it to setFetchImplementation signature.
todd.prod: troubleshooting table for quickstart: 
- "ReferenceError: fetch is not defined" -> run ESM/CJS snippet or paste global shim
- "stream aborted mid-response" -> try native edge runtime or update undici to latest
- "401 then retry breaks stream" -> enable SDK refresh-token hook and avoid retrying streaming POSTs
ci-bot: ci:tests triggered by @lin.sdk 1: running http-client-compat matrix.
lin.sdk: I'll open a PR with helpers + typedef + quickstart edits + sample-apps. Will iterate on fixes if CI shows stream issues.
sam.devex: thanks all 1: I'll add the quick copy into docs once PR lands.
